title: mut.concept_slow_art
mutation_directive: Channel SLOW ART (Slow Art Day movement, Olafur Eliasson's pacing) — art that demands sustained attention, rewards patience, punishes scanning. Translate: the piece should appear nearly static for the first 30 seconds, then reveal a slow transformation that becomes apparent over 60-120s of continuous viewing (color drift across regions, particles migrating in and out of dense zones, a hidden form emerging through fog). No sudden events. No clear loops. The viewer who scrolls past sees nothing; the one who waits sees the work. Display a tiny breath-counter in the corner so the patient viewer is acknowledged.
